$comment: The recorded state of the block-renderers acceptance criterion
`acceptance:block-renderers:ci` compares a run to this file and fails on drift in EITHER
direction: a newly-red assertion fails, and so does a newly-green one nobody recorded.
Every assertion is measured and passes, on all three surfaces. A5-A8 are split by where
they are measured: `-storefront` in a scaffolded storefront built with `next build`,
`-platform` / `-email` through the admin routes of the real composition root booted against
the tarball with the module switched on, off and on again, `-admin` in an instance scaffolded
by `endora new instance`, installed from a local registry and built with Vite, and
`-package` on the packed e-mail layer alone.
The run needs ACCEPTANCE_DATABASE_URL (a database whose name contains `test`) and REDIS_URL,
and exits 2 without them. Recorded from a run on 2026-10-04.
